action.name: Button Guard · Button brace grants shields to its row.
Sock Skipper · Pocket skip steals 1 shared energy and hits the rear.
Spool Ram · Every third round charges a double-power front-row sweep.
Needle Moth · Needle rain applies Scald to the rear row.
Teacup Healer · Refills the most wounded ally by 65 HP.
Yarn Giant · Every third round Loomfall sweeps the front and Tangled threads appear.
Binding Thread · Knots apply Tangle to the weakest cat.
Practice Cushion · A gentle third-round bump teaches a break interrupt.

method: 41 normalized-time samples of actual AnimationMixer tracks on loaded GLB rigs. Joint world transforms are expressed relative to each model, then relative to its unanimated rest pose. Positions are divided by model height. Quaternion distance is geodesic angular RMS. Every same-cat pair and every same-slot pair across starter cats must pass both thresholds. Colour, silhouette and camera do not enter the metric. Filmstrips use the actual gallery render path at eight equally spaced action times.
